title: Vaporous Nocturne over Fading Mountains
description: An abstract nocturne in irregular blue, turquoise and lavender color planes, with a winding band of gold and fine botanical marks.
alt: Irregular blue and turquoise mountain planes, lavender patches, fine dark tree and seed-head symbols, and a pale gold current beneath a light circular form.
